messages:
alex_cs: FYI — we're rolling a rate cap change for MapleHealth on 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC. Need to line up customer comms + CSM outreach. @maria_csm can you lead?

maria_csm: Yep, I can. Quick ask: what's changing exactly and will this affect peak traffic? :eyes:

alex_cs: Change = per-minute request cap from 120 -> 60 for the account tier. Aimed at controlling burst costs; sustained throughput not impacted. See short metrics below.

alex_cs: ```
Usage (30d): avg req/min 42, p95 98
Peak day: 4/2 peak 185 req/min (3 short spikes, 2 lasted <3m)
Errors (30d): 0.8% overall, spike correlated w/ 4/2 deploy
Latency: median 80ms, p95 420ms (spikes during 185 req/min)
Spend: $3.2k/mo estimate at current rate
``` 

maria_csm: OK - so spikes exceed new cap only on a few short bursts. We'll warn them and offer guidance: recommend short client-side backoff and request batching. Draft outreach please.

julie_eng: I'll add a micro-rollout plan and a fallback. Engineering will gate the cap behind a feature flag so we can rollback. ETA to flag + smoke tests: today EOD.

sanjay_se: I'll confirm the behavior on our side: requests over cap will receive 429 w/ Retry-After header. We'll make sure logs include snippet for customer to correlate.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created for 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC (window 30m) — maintenance ID: maint-9731

maria_csm: Draft outbound for review:

julie_eng: ```
Subject: Notice: upcoming rate limit for MapleHealth

Hi MapleHealth team,

We will be applying a per-minute request limit to your account on 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC to improve service stability. Typical traffic won't be affected; you may see 429 responses during short high-traffic spikes.

To prepare:
- Implement exponential backoff and check for `Retry-After` on 429s
- Consider request batching for bulk ops
- Reach out to your CSM if you expect scheduled high-traffic windows

If you'd like, we can whitelist a short burst for X hours while you adjust.

Thanks,
Maria (CSM) & Redwood Engineering
```

maria_csm: LGTM. Alex — can you approve the whitelist offer (if we want to allow it) and confirm any internal limits for it?

alex_cs: Approve. Offer = one 2-hour temporary burst with 3x cap, requires SE review + CSM request ticket. We'll track via incident tags.

maria_csm: I'll send at 2026-04-10 16:00 UTC to give them 48h notice. Who's sending the email? I'll send from my account and paste the SE contact.

sanjay_se: Please cc eng-support@redwood and include logs we discussed if they hit 429s.

julie_eng: I'll post rollout checklist in the ticket: smoke tests, monitoring dashboards, rollback steps.

alex_cs: Thanks all. Post any customer replies here. :thumbsup:
